steps.domain_action: Identify the fundamental tau anyon charge.
Branch the tau anyon into its constituent fusion channels.
Assign the non-trivial tau channel to the primary arm.
Apply a braiding operation to the tau channel state.
Compose the state with an F-matrix basis transformation.
Assign the identity channel to the secondary arm.
Apply the inverse braiding operation to the identity channel.
Recombine the channels to recover the original tau anyon.
Hold the resulting state in a coherent superposition.
Record the final topological state as a permanent witness.
Anchor the operation within the modular tensor category boundary.
